verdict.rationale: Supabase explicitly supports local development (CLI init/start), database branching that creates isolated preview environments 'without affecting your production setup', and self-hosting via Docker — all giving AI-native users a sandbox to test against without touching production data. This is corroborated by a Supabase CEO comment pushing users toward branching/migrations rather than direct prod dashboard edits (supabase-comm-7), reinforcing that this is a real, actively promoted workflow. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation that branching preserves realistic data/schema parity, and no direct AI-native example of an agent operating specifically within a Supabase branch/sandbox rather than production.
